title: Per-iteration run progress digest (_progress.json)
description: The machine-readable status of a run in flight (issue #76). Written by an OBSERVER on a harness daemon thread - never from inside the mobsim (the telemetry isolation rule, DECISIONS.md 9.36) - and replaced atomically as iterations complete. It reports the state of the RUN and refuses to report a finding: nothing in it is a result. Per-mode shares are reported for every mode individually, never as an aggregate row.

stalled.description: true when matsim.log has gone untouched longer than the declared RUN.monitor.stall_s

mode_share_last_iteration.description: The newest modestats.csv row: one key per mode, every mode individually. Shares are MATSim's own per-iteration selected-plan fractions - neither chosen modes at convergence nor completed trips, so never a result (DECISIONS.md 9.12).

relaxation.description: summarise_run.relaxation's verdict block - the single implementation, so the digest, the live view and the finished summary cannot disagree. Carries the drift trajectory against the declared RUN.relaxation.drift_tolerance_pp.

pace.description: s/iteration against the declared RUN.monitor.pace_band_s. solo_in_band mechanises the conditional-replication rule (DECISIONS.md 9.72): arm B launches only if arm A's solo iterations 2-5 pace inside the closed family's band.

write_failures.description: present when earlier digest writes failed; the observer surfaces its own failures rather than raising into the run
